enabled.label: Enable Skip Campaign
enabled.description: Allows players who check Skip Campaign during character creation (or run /skipcampaign apply) to start directly in endgame.

requireLeagueCompletion.label: Require Prior League Completion
requireLeagueCompletion.description: When enabled, requires at least one living character in the exact same league (respecting SSF and Hardcore death isolation) at or above the completion level or in Karui Shores.

startingAreaId.label: Starting Town Area Id
startingAreaId.description: WorldAreas town Id assigned as LastTown before first area login (default: Karui Shores 2_11_endgame_town).

startingLevel.label: Starting Character Level
startingLevel.description: Initial character level applied before S->C 0x15 / 0x13 character creation completes.

grantCampaignPassiveBooks.label: Grant Campaign Passive Books
grantCampaignPassiveBooks.description: Applies all Acts 1-10 campaign Book of Skill quest flags (+23 passive points; Bandits are left open so you can still choose).

grantAscendancyTrials.label: Grant Campaign Ascendancy Trials
grantAscendancyTrials.description: Awards Normal, Cruel, and Merciless Labyrinth ascendancy points (6 points) on first login.

startingGold.label: Starting Gold
startingGold.description: Gold credited to the player's league stash on first login.

refundPoints.label: Starting Refund Points
refundPoints.description: Minimum passive refund points granted to skipped characters on first login.
